`1-1`: _📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Package name `e2e_encryption` violates Go naming convention.** The rename from `e2eencryption` to `e2e_encryption` introduces an underscore. Per coding guidelines, package names must not contain underscores. This same rename also appears in `encryption_test.go` and `main_test.go`. The blank import in `main.go` uses the directory path, so the package name isn't constrained by OTE and can remain underscore-free (e.g. `e2eencryption`). As per coding guidelines: "Do not use uppercase characters, underscores, or dashes in package names."

Make the change consistently across the encryption test package files so the package identifier matches the coding guidelines. ```
